purpose: Authorized next P0-04 concept pass: two distinct car families and shared player/pedestrian style, Petrol & Coral and smooth stylized 3D. Current review candidate is v2; neither scale nor gameplay readability is measured.

concepts.reference_role: Palette and smooth rendering style reference.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original vehicle and character design sheet for a smooth stylized 3D top-down arcade city game, P0-04 reference only.
Input image: style and palette reference ONLY. Retain the reference's smooth painted 3D materials, bevels, rich petrol/teal bases, coral, cobalt and amber accents. Do not reuse its scenery; make a clear asset design sheet.
Primary request: A polished landscape concept sheet titled "PETROL & CORAL — CARS & PEOPLE" on a quiet deep petrol/slate background. Present TWO clearly different original cars in the top half and FOUR human variants in the bottom half, each as isolated smooth 3D designs viewed EXACTLY vertically from above. All are rendered with clean smooth shading, softly rounded edges and crisp antialiasing, NO pixel-art textures, sprites, voxel cubes, noisy shading or gritty surfaces.
CAMERA IS STRICT: perfectly vertical 90-degree nadir orthographic plan view, optical axis directly downward. No isometric angle, no perspective foreshortening, no front or side vehicle views. Cars must look like roof/bonnet/trunk plans. Humans upright, viewed from overhead showing the crowns of heads, broad shoulders, tops of arms and small visible feet, never a front-facing headshot or a full frontal body portrait. Light from upper left, short soft contact shadows; no hard dark large shadows mistaken for outlines.
TOP HALF: Two cars side-by-side at the SAME physical scale, pointing toward the top of the page. Left label "COMPACT HATCHBACK": coral body, short almost rectangular chunky silhouette, stubby rounded nose, compact cabin covering most length, short rear hatch with no distinct extended trunk, broad upright rear window, wheels close to corners, simple bumpers. Right label "LONG SEDAN": amber body, distinctly longer slab-shaped silhouette, broad long bonnet, separate cabin and distinct extended flat trunk behind rear window, slightly squared-off corners. Sedan approximately one third longer than hatchback but only slightly wider. Both evoke ordinary funny everyday cars, not futuristic or race vehicles. Opaque dark blue-gray windows, broad controlled smooth specular highlights, a few deliberate body seams only, no fine grille detail, no modeled occupants, no logos. Beside or underneath each car place a small monochrome ivory top-view silhouette of the exact same outline, so shape differences can be judged without the color.
BOTTOM HALF: Four equally enlarged top-down human studies using identical body/rig proportions, arranged left to right and labeled "PLAYER", "PEDESTRIAN A", "PEDESTRIAN B", "PEDESTRIAN C". Human height implied about 1.8m; these studies are enlarged for inspection, not at the car row's scale. Stylized readable heads, broad shoulders, natural arms and thick simple legs, compact rounded hands and feet, smooth skin and clothing surfaces, no tiny facial details. Player: warm ivory jacket with wide coral shoulder stripe, dark petrol trousers, dark hair, clearly asymmetric forward pistol-holding stance with one arm extending above the head in plan view so facing reads. No armor, helmet, glowing outlines, uniform, backpack or sci-fi gear. Pedestrians share same proportions, with simple short-hair/round-cap variants and distinctive broad clothing blocks: cobalt jacket, coral shirt, and amber top; hands relaxed in walking poses with a slight arm/foot swing, no weapons. Dark trousers, lightly contrasting hands/head; ordinary people with playful chunky proportions. For the player and one pedestrian, include a small monochrome ivory overhead silhouette directly below showing the arm/pose difference.
A narrow footer label reads "OVERHEAD DESIGN STUDIES · CHARACTER VIEWS ENLARGED · CONCEPT SCALE ONLY". Keep typography restrained, readable and accurate, no invented dimensions or technical tables.
Overall style: clean modern stylized 3D, smooth continuous material shading, not flat vector drawings, not photorealistic texture, not retro/pixel art. Deep vibrant colors, calm background, plenty of separation around every subject. Original designs only. Exactly two car families, four human variants, no scenery, extra cars, extra weapon lineup, UI, architecture, nighttime lighting, bloom, fog or depth of field. This is a concept sheet, not a validated model or screenshot.

concepts.reference_role: Edit target; preserve people and sheet style while correcting car geometry/silhouettes.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised P0-04 cars and people reference sheet.
Input image: EDIT TARGET, the full "PETROL & CORAL — CARS & PEOPLE" sheet.
Keep the sheet title, petrol background, smooth shaded 3D rendering style, labels, lower player/pedestrian row and footer unchanged. Keep the people as shown. ONLY redesign the top two cars and their little silhouette samples to make them far more different. Do NOT merely change their colors or stretch the same vehicle.
Left COMPACT HATCHBACK: redraw as a very short chunky BOX-SHAPED everyday hatchback. Rectangular outline with small rounded bevel corners, wide upright cabin, extremely short flat bonnet, cabin extending almost to a squared-off rear hatch; no separate trunk. Squarer roof, shorter wheelbase, four tiny simple rectangular headlights cues only viewed from above, NOT a curvy sports hatch with almond headlights. Coral smooth painted body and opaque dark blue windows. Its top-down body should be roughly 290px long and 160px wide at the current sheet scale, shorter vertically than the old car. Same facing direction, north, keep layout centered.
Right LONG SEDAN: redraw as a long boxy everyday saloon, amber painted body. Top-down body roughly 430px long and 160px wide at the same scale, approximately 45 percent longer than the hatchback while SAME width. Large clearly distinct long flat front bonnet, smaller central cabin, separate broad flat rear trunk with significant rear overhang. Clearly three volumes visible from plan, square-ended nose and tail with small rounded bevels, clean broad continuous highlights, dark blue opaque glass, simple details only. Not a modern tapered sporty sedan.
Absolute top-down vertical orthographic camera for BOTH cars, no perspective foreshortening, no visible grille/front/side body faces. Cars are at equal physical scale. Display the exact outer contours underneath/beside as pure solid ivory FILLED SILHOUETTES without cutouts for windows or line details: silhouettes must faithfully reflect the short square hatchback and long three-volume sedan. Give both silhouettes equal-scale widths and clearly different lengths. Leave a little room around each, preserve human row from the existing target. The shape difference must be instantly visible even if cars are monochrome.
Do not modify the palette, add extra car designs or scenery, or introduce pixel art, texture noise, realism, gritty marks, neon outlines, sci-fi styling, HUD or dimensions in text. Original clean smooth stylized 3D concept art.
